# Hybridata Solutions LLC
> Fort Worth, Texas contractor for DFW low voltage and IT integration, providing structured cabling, data center and outside-plant fiber, fusion splicing and testing, network design, Ekahau wireless site surveys, access control and surveillance for commercial facilities.

Service area: Dallas–Fort Worth and Texas; Hybridata also takes projects outside Texas.

## Services
- [Data center fiber and structured cabling](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-data-center-fiber-structured-cabling.html)
- [Fusion splicing and fiber testing](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-fusion-splicing-fiber-testing.html)
- [OSP fiber and route/permit/ROW coordination](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-osp-fiber-route-permit-row-coordination.html)
- [Network engineering, design-assist and consulting](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-network-engineering-design-assist-consulting.html)
- [Wireless site surveys, design and installation](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-wireless-site-surveys-design-installation.html)
- [Access control and surveillance](https://hybridatasolutions.com/service-access-control-surveillance.html)
